*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /Users/divadbaroon/Projects/Dynamite/dynamite/cluster.py
+"""Embed forum posts (cached) and cluster them with HDBSCAN."""
+import json, os
+from pathlib import Path
+import numpy as np
+import pandas as pd
+import hdbscan
+from openai import OpenAI
+
+CACHE = Path("data/emb.parquet")
+
+
+def embed(posts, model="text-embedding-3-small", batch=200):
+    have = pd.read_parquet(CACHE) if CACHE.exists() else pd.DataFrame(columns=["id", "vec"])
+    todo = [p for p in posts if p["id"] not in set(have.id)]
+    if todo:
+        client = OpenAI()  # reads OPENAI_API_KEY from the environment
+        rows = []
+        for i in range(0, len(todo), batch):
+            chunk = todo[i:i + batch]
+            res = client.embeddings.create(model=model, input=[p["text"][:8000] for p in chunk])
+            rows += [{"id": p["id"], "vec": d.embedding} for p, d in zip(chunk, res.data)]
+        have = pd.concat([have, pd.DataFrame(rows)], ignore_index=True)
+        have.to_parquet(CACHE)
+    by = dict(zip(have.id, have.vec))
+    return np.array([by[p["id"]] for p in posts], dtype=np.float32)
+
+
+def cluster(X, min_cluster_size=15, min_samples=5):
+    X = X / np.linalg.norm(X, axis=1, keepdims=True)  # cosine via euclidean on unit vectors
+    return hdbscan.HDBSCAN(min_cluster_size=min_cluster_size, min_samples=min_samples, metric="euclidean").fit_predict(X)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    posts = [json.loads(l) for l in open("data/posts.jsonl")]
+    X = embed(posts)
+    for mcs in (10, 15, 25):
+        lab = cluster(X, mcs)
+        n = lab.max() + 1
+        print(f"min_cluster_size={mcs:>2}: {n:>3} clusters, noise {np.mean(lab == -1):.0%}")
*** End Patch

Embeddings cached in `data/emb.parquet` (3,100 × 1536; the key is only read from the environment by the OpenAI client).

| min_cluster_size | clusters | noise |
|---|---|---|
| 10 | 63 | 31% |
| 15 | 41 | 24% |
| 25 | 22 | 19% |

15 looks like the sweet spot: 41 clusters is still reviewable by hand, and 25 merges threads that are clearly different topics (I spot-checked cluster 4 at mcs=25: it mixes "group project logistics" with "grading complaints"). `min_samples=5` is fixed for all three runs.
